body.statement: For every \(S\in\mathcal P_k\), every compatible \(y\), and every \(\pi\in\mathcal F\), the identified set for \(V_{\mu}(\pi)\) over \(\mathcal M_N\) conditional on \(y\) is exactly \([L_S(\pi;y),U_S(\pi;y)]\). One response schedule \(\mu^{-}\) attains all lower endpoints and one response schedule \(\mu^{+}\) attains all upper endpoints simultaneously over \(\mathcal F\).
body.justification: The common lower and upper schedules are the causal sharpness result: a single observational equivalence class supports every endpoint reported for the reusable future-policy library.
body.gap: ChenOberst2025 proves tight monotonicity bounds for reusable validation; the bounded Lipschitz score geometry and two common finite-population endpoint schedules for an entire prespecified library are not stated there.
body.consumer: A hospital can report auditable sharp value intervals for every prespecified deterministic model update from one trial panel.
